notes: README numbers match the record. A WebSearch snippet of arXiv 2606.18900 ('Compressed-Resident Genomics: Full-Pipeline Device-Resident GPU LZ77 Decode with Position-Invariant Random Access') repeats the H100 figures (364.9 GB/s encode, 592.5 GB/s decode, nvcomp-ANS measured at 480 GB/s), so the claim is corroborated but unopened (arXiv blocked); a retier to B is possible from an environment that reaches arXiv. Repo archived 2026-06-14, MIT, 396 stars, last commit 2026-03-18, so 'abandoned' is correct.

tier_reason: The README gives first-party speedups vs FSE-ANS on a Xeon Gold 5220S (1.92x compression, 2.04x decompression) and vs nvCOMP Huffman on an A100 (45.14x), with no compiler flags or stated benchmark command for those figures. The SC25 paper's abstract (seen in a search snippet) confirms only the 1.24x ratio gain, 870.27 MB/s CPU throughput and the GPU-vs-own-CPU speedups, not the FSE throughput win, and the paper itself could not be opened (ACM blocked).

corrections.caveats: README numbers only: the figure images (THR.png, CR.png) carry the detail, and no compiler flags or exact benchmark commands are given for the published figures (the repo does ship cpu_mans_bench and an autotune tool). A peer-reviewed SC25 paper (doi 10.1145/3712285.3759825) and an SC25 Reproducibility Report for it (doi 10.1145/3712285.3769469) exist, but ACM is blocked here so neither was opened; a verifier with ACM access could raise the tier to B. The abstract (search snippet) mentions the 1.24x average ratio gain, 870.27 MB/s CPU throughput and the 288.45x/135.86x GPU-vs-CPU speedups, not the FSE throughput comparison. The README's 2.37x figure is attributed to 16-bit Huffman in Key Features but to FSE-ANS (-r mode) in the ratio section. The 288x and 135x figures compare GPU to the project's own CPU mode, not to a third-party baseline.

notes: README numbers match the record; MIT, 11 stars, not archived, last commit 2026-09-30 ('dcu & amd version'). The SC25 reproducibility report is worth a retier check from an environment with ACM access, since an artifact-evaluation report is independent measurement.

tier_reason: The README table (i7-9700K, gcc 11.2) compares against the project's own naive loop plus Ryg's and Countbench's histogram code, and the benchmark driver (turbohist.c, makefile) is public; but the README does not say which makefile options (AVX2=1 or default, RDTSC) produced the table, so the flags used are not stated and the tier stays C.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: gcc 11.2 (README); the makefile builds with -O3 -fstrict-aliasing -falign-loops plus -march=corei7-avx by default or -march=haswell with AVX2=1, but the README does not say which configuration produced the table
